summary: Require EKODI to verify every public home, My page, operator page and administrator surface itself through synthetic role/device/browser execution and a real canonical production canary before normal completion.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI on 2026-09-22 to make comprehensive self-verification and empirical validation of all administrator pages, public homes, My pages, operator pages and the platform-wide My page an operating constitution, including EKODI-run virtualization or equivalent automated verification.
adds: universal SYSTEM_VERIFIED completion gate for governed UI surfaces
safe public projection and RBAC verification
manual user testing is additive rather than the default gate
preserves: virtualization as one method rather than the platform architecture
rollback: Revert constitution v1.18.0, SURFACE-SYSTEM-VERIFICATION-001, its operational config/validator/test and agent inheritance rule to v1.17.0. Do not alter workspace identity, user data, production domains or authorization records during rollback.
